== Summary ==
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 11 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): captioned by the photographer "soon to be world champ Hunter"; [[Brian Hunter]] (right foreground, long hair and white SWCCG shirt; matches [[:File:Brian Hunter FreedomCon 2001.jpg]] and [[:File:DecipherCon 2002 Day 2 Hunter and Brentson.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled.

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096155121/ soon to be world champ Hunter] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2593/4096155121_2bdb3746ca_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
